run_tao_bench_server: run the tao_bench_server memcached benchmark server with configurable threads, memory, and TLS options
run_tao_bench_client: run the tao_bench_client benchmark workload against a memcached server with warmup and test phases
affinitize_nic: configure NIC channel count and CPU affinity for network interface performance tuning
profile_server: capture a perf record profile of all processes for 5 seconds into perf.data
get_client_cmd: build the tao_bench_client command with calculated key range, threads, and clients per thread
